n.description: chunk number to read, exactly as shown in `[#n]` in a search result (page number for PDFs)

page_image.description: PDF only: return a raster of page `n` as JPEG (200 DPI) instead of text/embeds. Use when tables or layout are hard to read as text. Requires the server to be started with --vision.

path.description: document path, exactly as shown in a search result
